name: PositionManager mints deposit shares from the PancakeSwap V3 spot price
summary: The PositionManager vault's permissionless deposit values its existing USDT holdings in BTCB at the USDT/BTCB PancakeSwap V3 pool's slot0 price, the same pool its liquidity sits in, and withdraw pays out pro rata at once. With flash-loaned USDT the attacker crashed the pool's USDT price, then deposited and withdrew 1M USDT 24 times, each deposit minting excess shares that redeemed real value.
notes: The reset is changePoolData pointing the vault at the USDT/BTCB pool, BTC/USD feed and BTCB (slots 0x8, 0xa, 0xb, 0xe), seven months before the exploit; the manager's later updatePosition tick moves are live position management.

Loss is the USDT the vault's pool position lost net of the 15.49 USDT deposit fee paid to the protocol's own ProtocolManager, which equals the attacker's profit. No earlier transaction made more than one deposit.
